exposure: mode of birth (vaginal birth, cesarean delivery)
cohort: The study participants were women categorized into three groups: those who had vaginal births, those who had cesarean deliveries, and those who had cesarean deliveries with Placenta Accreta Spectrum, from whom placental tissue was obtained.
finding: The placentas of women with Placenta Accreta Spectrum showed significantly increased levels of DNMT1, DNMT3A, DNMT3L proteins and higher global DNA methylation compared to control groups.
cross-section timing: At the time of birth/delivery, from placental tissue.
